title: Planeó una masacre escolar con ChatGPT, intervino el FBI y no recibirá ninguna pena

reading.body:
This is a case of a general-purpose conversational system used outside the conditions it was built for. The chatbot was not the actor and carried out nothing itself. It was the tool a 15-year-old in Quilmes used to work out a plan to kill his classmates, a plan initially set for 2027, and the planning lived in his conversations before it lived anywhere else.

The failure sits at the point of use, in an end user's sessions with a system that placed no check between the conversation and the plan being formed. Nothing in the deployment stopped the planning. Detection came from outside the session: the conversations were discovered, the FBI gave notice, and the Federal Police investigation that began in August identified the teenager through social media before the raid on his home in Quilmes. Catching this at the point of use would have required the system itself to flag the sessions, rather than depending on the conversations being found and passed on. How they reached the FBI is not established in the reporting.

One outlet reported that the teenager will receive no penalty, and that is a report rather than a judicial finding. The plan was not carried out, and the seized items were turned over to the courts for expert analysis. Whether the conduct amounts to a crime, and what responsibility attaches to a 15-year-old, are matters before the Juvenile Criminal Responsibility Prosecutor's office and are not resolved by the reporting.

reports.title: Un adolescente planificó con la Inteligencia Artificial matar a sus compañeros de colegio: fue detectado por el FBI y allanado en Quilmes

Un adolescente planificó con Inteligencia Artificial matar a sus compañeros: el FBI dio aviso y lo allanaron en Quilmes
Planeó una masacre escolar con ChatGPT, intervino el FBI y no recibirá ninguna pena

summary:
A 15-year-old teenager in Quilmes, Argentina, planned a school shooting with the help of artificial intelligence, with intentions to target and kill his classmates. The FBI detected the plot after discovering the teenager's conversations with ChatGPT about organizing a massacre, initially planned for 2027. Federal Police conducted an investigation starting in August and identified the teenager through social media. Authorities raided his home in Quilmes and seized tactical gear including two pairs of tactical gloves, camouflaged military beanies, a skull-patterned balaclava, military camouflage scarves, and black tactical protection glasses, along with two cell phones.

Following the search, the teenager's parents were summoned along with the minor to the Juvenile Criminal Responsibility Prosecutor's office. The teenager's identity remains confidential for legal reasons. All seized materials were turned over to the courts for expert analysis. The investigation was led by the Federal Police's Anti-Terrorism Investigation Unit under Prosecutor Walter Bruno.
title_en: He planned a school massacre with ChatGPT, the FBI intervened and he will receive no punishment
